subject: Medford Square Historic Zoning Incentives
overview: The commission reviewed historic preservation incentives and design review mechanisms incorporated in the newly approved Medford Square zoning ordinance. Updates were also provided on ongoing municipal preservation projects and recent architectural revisions to the proposed Tufts University swimming pool facility.

items.title: Medford Square Zoning Discussion
items.summary: Doug Carr presented sections of the newly approved Medford Square zoning that incentivize historic preservation by offering dimensional waivers in exchange for design review, prompting discussion over how to resolve potential procedural conflicts with the city's demolition delay bylaw.

items.title: Vacant Seats and Onboarding
items.summary: The chair reported ongoing efforts to solicit applicants for commission vacancies, while a newly appointed member provided an update on finalizing onboarding and swearing-in steps.

items.title: Project Updates
items.summary: Hayward provided updates on various city projects, including Section 106 reviews, pending contracts for the Brooks Estate archaeological survey, tree clearing and plans for ground-penetrating radar at Thomas Brooks Park, stone and fence restoration work at Cross Street Cemetery, and ongoing neighborhood historic surveys.

items.title: Brooks Estate Parking Lot and Cemetery Expansion
items.summary: Carr addressed neighborhood concerns regarding planned parking facilities at the Brooks Estate and the long-planned expansion of Oak Grove Cemetery.

items.title: Tufts Swimming Pool Design Revisions
items.summary: Carr shared revised architectural drawings for the Tufts University swimming pool project that addressed previous design concerns by incorporating sawtooth windows and a glass vestibule to break up the brick exterior wall.

items.title: Meeting Minutes
items.summary: The commission approved the meeting minutes.
